name: OpenTherm Firmware ADR Audit
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'src/webhook.ino'
      - 'src/processPSSummary.cpp'
      - 'src/OTGW.ino'
      - 'src/OTGW.h'
      - 'docs/adr-044-webhook.md'
      - 'docs/adr-045-ps1-parsing.md'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'src/webhook.ino'
      - 'src/processPSSummary.cpp'
      - 'src/OTGW.ino'
      - 'src/OTGW.h'
      - 'docs/adr-044-webhook.md'
      - 'docs/adr-045-ps1-parsing.md'

jobs:
  audit-adr-compliance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify ADR-044 documentation exists
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "docs/adr-044-webhook.md" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: ADR-044 documentation missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✓ ADR-044 documentation found"

      - name: Verify ADR-045 documentation exists
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "docs/adr-045-ps1-parsing.md" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: ADR-045 documentation missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✓ ADR-045 documentation found"

      - name: Validate webhook.ino contains ADR-044 implementation
        run: |
          if ! grep -q "webhook.ino" "src/webhook.ino"; then
            echo "ERROR: webhook.ino does not contain expected ADR-044 implementation"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✓ webhook.ino contains ADR-044 implementation"

      - name: Validate processPSSummary.cpp contains ADR-045 implementation
        run: |
          if ! grep -q "processPSSummary" "src/processPSSummary.cpp"; then
            echo "ERROR: processPSSummary.cpp does not contain expected ADR-045 implementation"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✓ processPSSummary.cpp contains ADR-045 implementation"

      - name: Check for RFC1918/local URL enforcement
        run: |
          if ! grep -q "isLocalUrl" "src/webhook.ino"; then
            echo "ERROR: Missing isLocalUrl() enforcement in webhook.ino"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✓ RFC1918/local URL enforcement verified"

      - name: Check for payload template expansion
        run: |
          if ! grep -q "static char\[201\]" "src/webhook.ino"; then
            echo "ERROR: Missing payload template expansion buffer in webhook.ino"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✓ Payload template expansion verified"

      - name: Check for PS=1 format detection
        run: |
          if ! grep -q "comma count" "src/processPSSummary.cpp"; then
            echo "ERROR: Missing comma count format detection in processPSSummary.cpp"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✓ PS=1 format detection verified"

      - name: Check for PROGMEM lookup tables
        run: |
          if ! grep -q "PSSUMMARY_MSGIDS" "src/processPSSummary.cpp"; then
            echo "ERROR: Missing PROGMEM lookup tables in processPSSummary.cpp"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✓ PROGMEM lookup tables verified"

      - name: Check for serial buffer extension
        run: |
          if ! grep -q "512" "src/processPSSummary.cpp"; then
            echo "ERROR: Missing 512-byte serial buffer in processPSSummary.cpp"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✓ Serial buffer extension verified"

      - name: Notify Slack about successful audit
        if: success()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v2.1.1
        with:
          payload: |
            {
              "text": "OpenTherm Firmware ADR Compliance Check Passed",
              "blocks": [
                {
                  "type": "section",
                  "text": {
                    "type": "mrkdwn",
                    "text": ":white_check_mark: ADR-044 (Webhook) and ADR-045 (PS=1 parsing) compliance verified for ${{ github.sha }}"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "context",
                  "elements": [
                    {
                      "type": "mrkdwn",
                      "text": "Repository: ${{ github.repository }} | Branch: ${{ github.ref }}"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              ]
            }
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
